title: beta-nebula-expansion-v617
implementation: Added V617 expansion generator joining the sealed V613 18-candidate pack with six preserved v592 metadata/license identities: Ring, Dumbbell, California, Bubble, Cat's Eye and Omega.
Validated license-review, metadata-admission, metadata-acquisition and visual-acquisition receipt seals before creating expansion records; no historical receipt was rewritten.

Recorded acquisitionDecision, NASA ID, HTTPS source/preview URL, metadata digest, creator/credit, metadata state, payload state, local payload bytes/SHA/dimensions when present, and explicit blockers.

Kept California as one local payload with SHA/bytes/dimensions evidence; the other five remain metadata-only or license-blocked and carry payload-acquisition-pending rather than fabricated image fields.
Added TypeScript expansion utility with filtering, status labels, blocker labels, source/receipt summaries, payload counts, completion and fail-closed admission helpers.

Extended the nebula review panel with a V617 six-record expansion section showing 24-candidate total, 1 local payload, 5 pending acquisitions, next actions and candidate-only/science-payload-off boundaries.
